external_calibration.test: Each site has 82-day 96 civil-bin fixed-trained pairwise logscore. Compute a conservative LOWER score gap bound over each date's full source q interval using same q in both candidate models. Test Binomial(16,.5) right tail against .00625, exact criterion K>=14.
